description: Statistics of a gapped multiple alignment: per-sequence comparison with a reference row or the EMBOSS cons consensus (EMBOSS infoalign: seqLength, alignLength, gap runs, gap length, identities, similarities, differences, % change; verified against infoalign 6.6.0), per-column residue counts / gap fraction / most common residue / ClustalW conservation symbol ('*' identical, ':' strong, '.' weak group; ClustalW 2.1; DNA columns only '*'), gap percent, fully conserved and gap-free columns, and the pairwise percent-identity matrix (distmat uncorrected, identity over columns where neither row has a gap; gapWeight 1 = Biopython DistanceCalculator('identity')). Rows are upper-cased, '.'/'~' read as '-'.

sequences.description: At least two aligned sequences of equal length (DNA or protein, gaps '-').

residueType.description: 'auto' (type of the first row as EMBOSS), 'nucleotide' (EDNAFULL) or 'protein' (EBLOSUM62; also enables ':'/'.' conservation).

referenceSequence.description: infoalign -refseq: 0 = the EMBOSS cons consensus (default), k = the k-th sequence (1-based).

gapWeight.description: Weight of gap columns in the identity matrix denominator L - g + g*gapWeight (distmat -gapweight; default 0).

meanPairwiseIdentity.description: Mean off-diagonal percent identity (null when undefined).

sequences.description: Per-row infoalign statistics: index, sequenceLength, alignmentLength, gapRuns, gapLength, identities, similarities, differences, percentChange.

columns.description: Per-column: index, counts, gapCount, gapFraction, mostCommonResidue, mostCommonCount, conservation.

errors.message: At least two sequences are required
